desc: Read the input values $N$ and the sequence $P$.
Implement a Fenwick tree (Binary Indexed Tree) to support efficient updates and prefix sum queries.
Iterate backwards from $i = N$ down to $1$.
Calculate the final position of number $i$ by finding the smallest index $pos$ such that the number of currently *empty* positions in the range $[1, pos]$ equals $P_i$.
Mark position $pos$ as occupied (decrement count in BIT) and store the result.
Implement the full Python script with the optimized BIT logic (initialization, binary lifting, update, output) and run it.
Run the code against the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Ensure the solution handles the maximum constraint $N=5 \times 10^5$ within the time limit (typically 2 seconds for Python).
Run the code against Sample 1 and Sample 2 to verify correctness.
